clock_waveform.host_clock_source: PCI Express reference clock (100 MHz nominal); SerDes recovered clock internal to PCIe PHY.
clock_waveform.controller_clock_source: PCIe REFCLK on the connector; controller derives internal clocks via PLLs.
clock_waveform.protocol_layer_timing: NVMe protocol layer is event-driven and asynchronous from the host's CPU clock domain — there is no protocol-defined CLK signal at the NVMe layer; all transactions are PCIe TLP events.

doorbell_write_waveform.host_action: Host CPU performs an MMIO 32-bit write to the SQyTDBL register at offset 1000h + (2y * (4 << CAP.DSTRD)).
doorbell_write_waveform.transport: Translated by host root complex into a PCIe Memory Write TLP targeting the controller's BAR0/BAR1.
doorbell_write_waveform.controller_action: Controller decodes the TLP, latches the new SQ Tail Pointer, and schedules a fetch of pending SQ entries from the SQ ring.

sq_fetch_waveform.controller_action: Controller issues one or more PCIe Memory Read TLPs to the SQ ring (host memory at ASQ + Head * 64 bytes).
sq_fetch_waveform.transport: Root complex returns Memory Read Completion TLPs with the 64-byte SQE payload.
sq_fetch_waveform.controller_processes: Controller decodes CDW0.OPC + CDW0.PSDT + NSID; for data commands, follows PRP/SGL pointers to access data buffers.

data_transfer_waveform_read.controller_action: For Read (OPC=02h): controller issues PCIe Memory Write TLPs targeting host PRP/SGL data buffers; one or more TLPs per memory page; payload size limited by PCIe Max Payload Size (negotiated 128..4096 bytes).
data_transfer_waveform_read.metadata: If metadata present, written to MPTR (separate buffer) or interleaved per FLBAS.MS.
data_transfer_waveform_read.ordering: All data writes posted before the CQE write to enforce data-before-completion ordering.

data_transfer_waveform_write.controller_action: For Write (OPC=01h): controller issues PCIe Memory Read TLPs against host data buffers; reads return via Memory Read Completion TLPs; controller commits to media.
data_transfer_waveform_write.metadata: If metadata present, read from MPTR or per FLBAS.MS.

cqe_post_waveform.controller_action: Controller issues one PCIe Memory Write TLP targeting the CQ ring at ACQ + Tail * 16 bytes.
cqe_post_waveform.phase_tag: Phase Tag bit (DW3 bit 16) inverted on each ring wrap so host can polling-detect new entries without doorbell read.
cqe_post_waveform.ordering: CQE write is the producer barrier — controller ensures preceding data writes are globally observable before posting the CQE.

interrupt_waveform.msi_x_action: Controller issues an MSI-X Message TLP after posting one or more CQEs to the associated CQ; vector index is the CQ's IV (Create I/O CQ.CDW11[31:16]).
interrupt_waveform.host_action: Host CPU's interrupt controller delivers the IRQ; host reads CQEs from the corresponding CQ ring; writes CQyHDBL to release slots.

controller_initialization_waveform.step_1: Host BIOS/OS enumerates the PCI Function; assigns BAR0/BAR1 base addresses.
controller_initialization_waveform.step_2: Host driver reads CAP (8 bytes from offset 0h) and VS (4 bytes from offset 8h).
controller_initialization_waveform.step_3: Host writes AQA (sizes), ASQ (Admin SQ base), ACQ (Admin CQ base).
controller_initialization_waveform.step_4: Host writes CC with desired CC.MPS, CC.AMS, CC.CSS, CC.IOSQES=6, CC.IOCQES=4, CC.EN=1.
controller_initialization_waveform.step_5: Host polls CSTS.RDY until 1 (max CAP.TO × 500 ms); if CSTS.CFS=1, abort.
controller_initialization_waveform.step_6: Host issues Identify Controller (CNS=01h) via Admin SQ; rings SQ0TDBL=1; waits for completion in Admin CQ; writes CQ0HDBL=1.
controller_initialization_waveform.step_7: Host creates I/O queues via Create I/O CQ then Create I/O SQ; rings the appropriate doorbells.
controller_initialization_waveform.step_8: Controller is now in RUNNING state servicing I/O commands.

controller_shutdown_waveform.step_3: Controller drains outstanding work + flushes write cache (if normal); updates CSTS.SHST = 01b (shutdown in progress).
controller_shutdown_waveform.step_4: When complete, controller sets CSTS.SHST = 10b (shutdown complete).
controller_shutdown_waveform.step_5: Host may safely remove power or trigger PCIe Conventional Reset / Function-Level Reset.

nssr_waveform.step_1: If CAP.NSSRS=1, host writes 0x4E564D65 ('NVMe') to NSSR.NSSRC at offset 20h.
nssr_waveform.step_2: Subsystem performs an NVM Subsystem Reset; all controllers in the subsystem reset.
nssr_waveform.step_3: After reset, CSTS.NSSRO is set to 1 to indicate last reset was NSSR.
nssr_waveform.step_4: Host follows the same controller bring-up flow as power-on.

general_timing_rule: Underlying PCIe Transaction Layer enforces TLP ordering rules. Posted writes (MWr including CQE writes) cannot pass other posted writes. Read completion TLPs can be reordered relative to posted writes (Relaxed Ordering). The CAP.TO field gives the worst-case time for CC.EN 0→1 → CSTS.RDY=1 transition (and vice versa) in 500 ms units. Typical values are CAP.TO ≤ 60 (= 30 s).
